notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor 93e600d7) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.42 wheel; GPT-6 Luna (medium reasoning) through the OpenAI Responses API with an API key, flex service tier. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Replacements, originals kept as evidence: one sandbox connection error, and four long trials (train-fasttext ×3, extract-moves-from-video) cut off at 22:23Z on 1 October when the OpenAI organisation ran out of API credits (ApiUsageLimitError); one train-fasttext rerun failed the same way and one hit a verifier setup error, so that task took a chain of reruns. One gcode-to-text trial that exited non-zero on an OpenAI 400 is kept as an agent outcome. The original trials ran on Harbor 93e600d7.

Ran 1–3 October, after the flex serving anomaly bench-run recorded on 30 September–1 October (a faster serving path with lower task success, which wrote off three TB4 cohorts); no trial of this run falls in that window.

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each model call's token usage at OpenAI's flex rates (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.1; $0.05 / $0.005 / $0.25 per million input / cached / output tokens, $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.375 above 272k context; cache writes bill at the input rate). Recorded $3.30; repriced $3.27 over the same 450 trials. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
